summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with extensive feature engineering, deep learning, and advanced ensembling. However, it skips basic data cleaning (missing value/duplicate checks) and relies entirely on a single metric. More importantly, it reuses the same CV folds for both level-1 out-of-fold feature generation and level-2 meta-model training, causing a subtle but real target leakage that optimistically biases validation scores and early stopping.
